name: JW Marriott Los Cabos Beach Resort & Spa
insider_take: Where desert luxury meets the Sea of Cortez - this is Cabo's most sophisticated beachfront sanctuary.
whats_special: Built on one of Los Cabos' most pristine stretches of swimmable beach, this JW Marriott sits where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez. The resort features Mexico's largest spa and offers unobstructed views of the iconic Land's End rock formations. As part of Marriott's ultra-luxury Luminous Program, guests enjoy elevated amenities including personalized butler service and exclusive beach cabanas.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the resort's signature restaurant - you'll have front-row seats to watch whales migrate through the channel between December and April.
dont_miss: The world-famous Cabo Arch (El Arco) is just a 10-minute boat ride away, and the resort's private beach is one of the few in Cabo where you can actually swim safely. The nearby Pueblo Bonito Pacifica Golf Course offers stunning clifftop ocean views on every hole.
pros: Prime beachfront location on pristine Los Cabos coastline
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with signature treatments
Multiple gourmet dining venues featuring local and international cuisine
Exceptional service standards consistent with JW Marriott brand
cons: Remote location requires transportation to downtown attractions
